translations.web: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.
translations.bsb: The servant who had received the five talents went at once and put them to work and gained five more.
translations.kjv: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
translations.asv: Straightway he that received the five talents went and traded with them, and made other five talents.
